description: Image Description: The image shows a display of plush toys hanging in a setting that resembles a carnival or fair game booth. In the foreground, there are two blue cartoonish frog toys with large eyes and wide grins, hanging upside down. Each frog has a black mask-like pattern over its eyes and spots on its body. Between them is a beige teddy bear holding a red and yellow flower, and it is adorned with a red checkered scarf. In the background, there are various other plush toys
